title: Senior .NET Developer
description:

* Take ownership of assigned modules and ensure timely delivery with expected quality.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, security practices, and development best practices.

* Work closely with QA, BA, DevOps, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery.

* Ensure proper documentation of technical solutions, application changes, and deployment\-related activities.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and object\-oriented programming principles.
* Strong hands\-on experience in building and consuming REST APIs.
* Solid experience with SQL Server, including complex queries, stored procedures, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Strong working experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, Azure DevOps, Application monitoring and deployment
* Strong experience with Git and version control workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Entity Framework / EF Core or similar ORMs.
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Experience with debugging, testing, and API testing tools such as xUnit, NUnit, Postman, or equivalent.
* Understanding of application performance optimization, scalability, and security best practices.

**Technical Leadership \& Team Responsibilities**

* Provide day\-to\-day technical guidance and support to developers.
* Mentor team members and help them improve their technical skills and development practices.
* Review implementation approaches and identify potential technical risks at an early stage.
* Conduct regular code reviews and ensure code quality across assigned modules.
* Assist the Team Lead in technical estimation, planning, and task prioritization.
* Take ownership of critical modules and production issues.
* Ensure developers follow established coding, Git, testing, and deployment practices.
* Help identify recurring technical issues and recommend long\-term solutions.
* Act as a technical point of contact for the team in the absence of the Team Lead.

**Candidate Profile**

* 8\+ years of strong hands\-on experience in .NET development.
* Previous experience in a Senior Developer, Module Lead, or similar technical leadership role is preferred.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong understanding of existing applications and ability to quickly analyze complex codebases.
* Demonstrated ability to take end\-to\-end ownership of technical deliverables.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to mentor and guide team members effectively.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.

* Experience handling production\-critical issues and customer\-facing technical challenges.
* Ability to make sound technical decisions and recommend practical solutions.
* Willingness to learn and adopt new technologies, tools, and cloud services.

* Strong knowledge of ASP.NET Core, Web API, and RESTful services.

* Experience with SQL Server or Oracle, Entity Framework Core, and LINQ.
* Experience developing or integrating microservices.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorization, including JWT.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience migrating legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET.
* Knowledge of IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, or other message\-queue technologies.

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume, current CTC, expected compensation, notice period, and relevant .NET project experience.

You'll be working with an experienced engineering team on an existing production platform, contributing to new features, enhancements, integrations, performance improvements, and ongoing platform evolution.
